stem: Which problem is Nancy Reagan hoping to solve with this campaign?

options.label: A
options.text: Drug and alcohol abuse among children

options.label: B
options.text: The effects of video-game violence on children

options.label: C
options.text: Diets high in sugar and salt among children

options.label: D
options.text: The effects of explicit lyrics in music on children

visual_elements: Someone asked me if I wanted to make a New Year's wish, and I said yes—and it was that I'd like to see every young person in the world join the “Just Say No” . . . club. Well, just the fact that Congress has proclaimed “Just Say No Week” and in light of all the activities taking place, it seems that my wish is well on its way to coming true. I'm so proud of all the young people, the parents, the citizens in cities and towns across the Nation, the Government, and everyone else who's helping to create what I believe is the final solution to this problem. . . . —First Lady Nancy Reagan, May 20, 1986
